description:
Domain discovery from company name or domain hint.
When to use: Enrichment when the user needs the corporate domain for a company (or details for a domain).
Parameters: domain OR company — pass exactly one, not both.
CREDITS: Each successful call spends ZeroBounce account credits. Confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked for validation, enrichment, or activity data.

company.description: Company name to look up (alternative to domain)

name: find_domain
title: Find company domain
